name: OpenCode
summary: Open-source AI coding agent for the terminal.
description: OpenCode is a coding agent that works in the terminal: it reads your project, edits files and runs commands. It's open source and works with many model providers.
features: OpenCode is an AI product for coding and developer tools.

howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

features_fr: OpenCode est un produit d'IA pour les outils de codage et de développement.
